verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents encryption of state and plan files at rest, locally and in backends, with KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault, OpenBao). Encryption can be configured through the TF_ENCRYPTION environment variable instead of code, so secrets that flow through deployments are protected in persisted artifacts. The evidence does not show how input secrets are passed in or kept out of console and log output. missing for 10: documented sensitive variable/output marking, redaction of secrets in plan/apply logs, guidance on injecting secrets via environment variables or secret managers, independent corroboration.
